sentences: A reconciliation of non-GAAP guidance measures to corresponding GAAP measures is not available on a forward-looking basis without unreasonable effort due to the uncertainty of expenses that may be incurred in the future.

guidance.sentence: For FY26 and FY27, we have determined the projected non-GAAP tax rate to be 22%.

summary: GitLab says it is giving guidance for Q3 and full fiscal year 2027, but the excerpt omits the guidance figures; the only stated forward figure is a projected non-GAAP tax rate of 22% for FY27.
